description: The day's top-moving US stocks by percent change — PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "today's top stock gainers", "biggest US stock losers today", "most active stocks", "what stocks are up/down the most". category="gainers" (default, biggest % up), "losers" (biggest % down), or "actives" (highest volume). Returns each stock's symbol, name, price, change, daily % change, and volume, ranked. Live US market data, keyless (Yahoo Finance). These are % MOVERS — distinct from what's merely trending/discussed.
name: top_movers
title: Top Movers
